metadata.description: A collection of skills and plugins for everyday work.

plugins.name: humanized
plugins.description: Draft, edit, and review natural-sounding text for its audience and genre. Replace filler with concrete language, preserve the author’s voice and facts, and get specific feedback without rewriting.

plugins.name: character
plugins.description: Develop fictional characters and test how they act and speak in a scene that fits the book.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Review and commit the current task's changes with a task ID.

plugins.name: push
plugins.description: Commit the current task's changes and push the current branch.

plugins.name: mr
plugins.description: Review and publish the current task as a merge or pull request.

plugins.name: clean-merged-branches
plugins.description: Delete local Git branches already merged into main.
